info.title: KWIP Data Marketplace API
info.description: Public catalog, metered data delivery, scoped service keys, custom user-approved device linking, bounded Pro exports and operator push ingestion. Data is not seeded. This is HTTP API documentation, not an MCP server or OAuth specification. See /agents.txt. All JSON business responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Common peer ceiling 300 requests/minute; authenticated workspace default 120/minute, configurable. Honor Retry-After; metadata does not cost credits but is rate limited.

servers.description: Same origin as the served specification; production https://kwip.tech.

post.summary: Deliver a bounded metered record page
post.description: Requires datasets:read. Request JSON maximum 32768 bytes; default limit 25, maximum 100. Charge = returned records × dataset credits_per_record; empty pages cost zero. max_credits is an optional additional ceiling, not overage opt-in. Reuse the same key and identical full JSON for a retry; page/cursor changes need a new key. Workspace-wide receipt identity, cached replay 24h then 410 permanently. A signed 24h cursor pins snapshot/filter/projection/schema. Repeat filters and fields on each page; limit may change. Response maximum 1 MiB by default. Source/dataset revocation is checked on replay.

post.summary: Poll for a user-approved service key
post.description: Maximum body 4096 bytes. Poll no faster than every five seconds (60/minute per peer overall). Approval yields one consumable 90-day service key. No refresh token. A lost successful token response requires a new linking flow; do not blindly retry until success.

post.summary: Prepare a budget-limited Pro snapshot export
post.description: Requires active Pro plus datasets:read and exports:read. Body maximum 16384 bytes. CREDIT CONSENT: records are charged when prepared even if never downloaded; downloading existing artifact adds no charge. max_credits is required; not overage opt-in. Default limits 10000 rows, 10 MiB, 1000000 credits, 20 unexpired jobs/workspace; deployment may change these. Same caller/key + identical request ID/input replays original job. Artifacts expire 24h after creation. Worker required. Partial is not complete.

post.description: Operator browser session required. Defaults to dry_run=true. No dynamic SQL table. Register draft, separately register/approve sources, then publish. Schema versions immutable/additive. HTTP dataset object excludes sources; CLI combined manifests have a different wrapper. Slug identifies upsert; no Idempotency-Key used. Maximum HTTP body 1 MiB.

post.summary: Operator validates or registers a rights-reviewed source
post.description: Operator browser session required. Schema must already exist. Approval requires attribution/license evidence URL; operator must separately verify redistribution, retention, privacy, robots and rate policy. Merely public data/API access is not approval. URL is provenance; server does not fetch it. Maximum HTTP body 1 MiB.

post.summary: Operator pushes a validated observation batch
post.description: Requires operator identity and ingest:write; service keys need matching dataset/source restrictions. Source must be active/rights-approved even for dry run. HTTP body maximum 1 MiB (stricter than service canonical JSON 2000000-byte cap). Atomic 1–500 items, unique external IDs per batch. Defaults dry run. Identity=(source,external_id); new batch creates observations even when unchanged. Same source/key/input replay returns original batch with replayed=true, including when dry_run requested. Conflicting input returns 400 validation_error, NOT 409. Tombstone requires empty payload. No source fetching or scheduling.

400.description: validation_error including conflicting ingestion idempotency key.

default.description: JSON error. Common statuses: 400 validation; 401 missing/invalid credential; 403 authority; 405 method; 413 size; 415 JSON media type; 429 throttled (Retry-After); 503 unavailable. Error codes are extensible.

ServiceKey.description: Owner-created expiring/revocable service key; scopes datasets:read, exports:read, and operator-only ingest:write. Never sends key in URL.

BrowserSession.description: Short-lived active Clerk user session token from the configured first-party browser sign-in. Management actions require this scheme, not service keys. No cookie-only API authentication.

Scalar.description: Finite scalar matching the registered field type. Null and nested values are rejected. Integer fields are signed 64-bit; numeric fields have magnitude at most 1e100; strings at most 100000 characters.

Filters.description: Exact equality on schema fields, not operators or SQL. Datetime strings are compared literally. Omit or send null for no filters.

max_credits.description: Required consent ceiling. Deployment default maximum 1000000 credits; server configuration may lower or raise it.
